title: Speech Source
description: Defines the required metadata for every speech source (origin of a batch of recordings) in the Sauti Labs platform, per ADR-0002 and the Master Blueprint's Speech Data Platform (Pillar III). A source may yield many individual recordings, tracked separately in speech-recording.schema.json.

languages.description: ISO codes of languages covered, cross-referenced to Codex Layer 2.

acquisition_date.description: ISO 8601 date this source was acquired by Sauti Labs.

copyright_status.description: Copyright must never be assumed. 'unknown_pending_review' blocks use until resolved, mirroring corpus-registry's Copyright Discipline rule.

linked_dataset_ids.description: Cross-reference to dataset-framework registry entries derived from this source.

linked_recording_ids.description: Cross-reference to speech-recording.schema.json entries derived from this source.
